propositions: rebar comment accepts flag-like tokens (e.g. --body-file, --body) as the comment body instead of rejecting them, storing the flag string literally while discarding the intended content and exiting 0
a body argument beginning with - is silently consumed and stored rather than rejected, causing the user to believe the write succeeded when content was actually lost
positional-only body commands (comment, create, edit, session-log, tag, untag, archive, set-verify-commands) require a guard that rejects arguments starting with - unless explicitly escaped with --
the -- escape hatch must be implemented and documented to allow storing body text that legitimately begins with -
a secondary defect caused surplus positional arguments to be dropped via args[:min_args] slicing, compounding the data loss when users provided both flag and intended value
